 LIVE UPDATES MLB MLB Cy Young and All-MLB Team Awards Show, Latest Rumors, Updates and Reaction
 Joel Reuter Nov 11, 2026, updated just now 
 It is MLB awards week as we slap a bow on the 2026 season, and on Wednesday night the AL and NL Cy Young winners and All-MLB team selections will be revealed.
 This year also marks the first time the Baseball Writers' Association of America will be handing out AL and NL Reliever of the Year awards, and those winners will also be named following the Cy Young announcement.
 Keep it right here for all the winners, updates and live reaction on a busy Wednesday night of MLB award week.
 Live Updates
 5 Total Posts
 Newest First ​ Just Now 07:17 PM AL Cy Young Winner: Cam Schlittler
 Cam Schlittler becomes the seventh pitcher in Yankees history to win AL Cy Young honors, joining this group:
 Bob Turley (1958)
Whitey Ford (1961)
Sparky Lyle (1977)
Ron Guidry (1978)
Roger Clemens (2001)
Gerrit Cole (2023)
 8 mins ago 07:10 PM Building a Cy Young Winner
 A quick reminder that Cam Schlittler was a seventh-round pick out of Northeastern University in 2022, where he had a 3.44 ERA and 85 strikeouts in 91.2 innings during his final season.
 Props to the Yankees on maximizing his potential and helping him develop into a frontline starter.
 32 mins ago 06:46 PM Preseason AL Cy Young Odds
 Fun to look back at where things stood entering the season, and certainly not surprising to see Cam Schlittler and Parker Messick absent from the odds leaderboard.
 A bit surprising Dylan Cease didn't get more love given his swing-and-miss stuff and the massive seven-year, $210 million contract he had just signed.
 44 mins ago 06:34 PM AL Cy Young Finalists
 The question on the AL side isn't whether Cam Schlittler will win Cy Young honors, but if he'll do it unanimously.
 Tip of the cap to Parker Messick on becoming the sixth rookie in MLB history to finish in the top three in Cy Young voting, though he seems like a lock for the No. 3 spot in the balloting.
 48 mins ago 06:30 PM Catching Up on 2026 BBWAA Awards
 Mark Cunningham/Getty Images 
 While Gold Glove and Platinum Glove winners have already been revealed, Monday kicked off the beginning of the year's notable awards from the BBWAA, so let's recap the hardware that's been handed out so far:
 Monday: BBWAA AL, NL Rookie of the Year 
 AL winner: Kevin McGonigle, Detroit Tigers
NL winner: Sal Stewart, Cincinnati Reds
 Tuesday: BBWAA AL, NL Manager of the Year 
 AL winner: Will Venable, Chicago White Sox
NL winner: Pat Murphy, Milwaukee Brewers
